summary: Authored spec-lens-b.md specifying Given/When/Then scenarios, coverage analysis, untestable assertions, and citation manifest for skill anchoring and worktree cleanup guardrails.

hard_stops.hard_stop: The proposal does not determine what the system should do in a case, so the scenario would assert an outcome nobody chose.
Every scenario for a requirement would be untestable, meaning the requirement as proposed is unobservable.
Satisfying one instruction in this packet would require violating another.
